image_description: A side-profile view of a wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting on dirt ground with sparse vegetation. The rabbit has greyish-brown fur, long upright ears with pinkish interiors and dark tips, large dark eyes, and visible forelimbs tucked under its chest. The hind legs are partially visible but mostly obscured by the body angle. The background consists of tall green grass blades.

The paw structure appears somewhat indistinct and fused with the ground/fur. It lacks clear digit definition, looking more like a smooth stump than a clawed foot, which is a common AI artifact in small extremities.
